header.name: InvUI edit_box + button.send probe (DISPOSABLE WORLD ONLY)
header.description: Unverified edit_box + button.send probe: adds one positive-control label, one manually typed text field (edit_box named #message_text_box) and one button.send button to the vanilla chest screen panels so you can observe whether typed text is actually sent. Fixed text auto-send and script wiring are NOT provided; No interaction control and no item protection; normal chests and chat may be affected; no guarantee that anything is sent. Use only in a disposable world.
